name: Knucklehead Trout
publication: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden
otherStatistics: Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 8. Languages none.
appearance: A deep-bodied trout with a bulbous red forehead, small eyes, silver-gray belly, and a ruddy forked tail.

sections.Printed source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden, Appendix C, p. 295. First printing, August 2020. https://online.anyflip.com/jjlbf/giys/mobile/index.html#p=296
sections.Traits: Water Breathing. The trout breathes only underwater.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Fishing in Icewind Dale: Under the lake procedure on p. 11, use fishing tackle from a rowboat or fish through a hole cut in the ice with a saw or similar tool. After each hour, a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Survival) check hooks a trout. Then contest the angler’s Strength (Athletics) against the trout’s Strength check, which the trout makes with advantage. A win pulls the fish out. On a loss, the trout escapes. If the angler loses by 5 or more, they must make a DC 10 Dexterity save to avoid being pulled into frigid water. Once rescued, a soaked character remains subject to the frigid-water effects until their wet clothes are replaced with dry ones.

name: Mountain Goat
publication: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden
appearance: A shaggy cream-white goat with a narrow chin beard, dark hooves, and slim backward-curving black horns.

sections.Printed source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden, Appendix C, p. 304. First printing, August 2020. https://online.anyflip.com/jjlbf/giys/mobile/index.html#p=305
sections.Traits:
Charge. After moving at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and hitting it with Ram on that turn, deal 3 (1d6) extra bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 12 Strength save or fall prone.
Sure-Footed. The goat has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saves against effects that would knock it prone.
sections.Actions: Ram. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

name: Reindeer
publication: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden
appearance: A thick-coated caribou with broad hooves and branching antlers. About one in six Icewind Dale reindeer has antlers that glow.

sections.Printed source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden, p. 307, with pp. 11, 107 and 268. The adventure adapts the 2014 Monster Manual Elk on p. 322. First printing, August 2020. https://online.anyflip.com/jjlbf/giys/mobile/index.html#p=308
sections.Traits:
Charge. After moving at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and hitting it with Ram that turn, deal 7 (2d6) extra damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength save or fall prone.
Cold Acclimation. The reindeer automatically succeeds on the adventure’s hourly DC 10 Constitution save against extreme cold.
Glowing Antlers (roughly one in six). A reindeer with this trait sheds dim light in a 10-ft. radius.
sections.Actions:
Ram. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
Hooves. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone creature. Hit for 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

name: Seal
publication: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden
otherStatistics: Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 11. Languages none.
appearance: A silvery-gray seal with a rounded whiskered head, dark spots, and short foreflippers.

sections.Printed source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden, Appendix C, p. 308. First printing, August 2020. https://online.anyflip.com/jjlbf/giys/mobile/index.html#p=309
sections.Traits:
Hold Breath. The seal can hold its breath for 15 minutes.
Keen Smell. It has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that use smell.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 1 piercing damage.
sections.Adventure context: The seals from the Sea of Moving Ice are acclimated to cold weather, as described on p. 308. That acclimation is distinct from damage resistance.

name: Sperm Whale
publication: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Blindsight 120 ft. Passive Perception 11. Languages none.
appearance: An immense slate-gray toothed whale with a block-shaped forehead, a narrow lower jaw, and broad tail flukes.

sections.Printed source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden, Appendix C, p. 309. First printing, August 2020. https://online.anyflip.com/jjlbf/giys/mobile/index.html#p=310
sections.Traits:
Echolocation. The whale loses access to blindsight while deafened.
Hold Breath. It can hold its breath for 90 minutes.
Keen Hearing. It has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that use hearing.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Tail attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 21 (3d8 + 8) piercing damage. A Large or smaller creature hit must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity save or be swallowed. A swallowed creature has total cover from attacks and other effects outside the whale and takes 3 (1d6) acid damage at the start of each of the whale’s turns. If one creature inside the whale deals it at least 30 damage on a single turn, the whale must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution save at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures. They fall prone in a space within 10 ft. of the whale. If the whale dies, a swallowed creature can use 20 ft. of movement to leave the corpse, exiting prone.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit for 18 (3d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage. Against an object, deal 37 (6d6 + 16) bludgeoning damage instead.

name: Walrus
publication: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden
appearance: A bulky marine mammal with a broad whiskered muzzle, heavy flippers, and two long ivory tusks.

sections.Printed source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden, Appendix C, p. 312. First printing, August 2020. https://online.anyflip.com/jjlbf/giys/mobile/index.html#p=313
sections.Traits: Hold Breath. The walrus can hold its breath for 10 minutes.
sections.Actions: Tusks. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 7 (2d4 + 2) piercing damage.
